summary: Signed into law August 10, 2026 following an 11-0 council vote. Temporarily prohibits the Department of Permitting Services from issuing data center permits for 18 months, alongside an amended zoning measure placing limitations on data center development.

source.citation: Montgomery County Council release, July 28 2026; dcmap.us policy tracker

notes: The county describes the 18-month term as a compromise between a six-month proposal and a two-year proposal. The amended zoning measure is described as a bridge to a future, more extensive zoning framework. A permit moratorium is a distinct instrument from an application moratorium: it reaches projects that have already been approved but not yet permitted.
